notes.subject: ממזרים
notes.rationale: 'Yɛlɛyɛliw-sanbagaw' (scatterers = saheli-yɛlɛyɛliw) ni 'saheli-fɛ' (KJV) ni 'Arturus' (Wycliffe) — Heburukan fɔcogo ye 'sanbagaw' ye

notes.subject: ממזרים
notes.rationale: Daɲɛ nɔgɔman don Tanaki kɔnɔ — 'sanbagaw', saheli-fɛ yɛlɛyɛli minnu bɛ kilisiw san

notes.subject: חדר
notes.gloss: so kɔnɔ legen yɔrɔ — 'so-kɔnɔ' fɔcogo; KJV ye 'saheli' fɔ, nka Heburukan fɔcogo ye so-kɔnɔ yɔrɔ ye

translation: Yɛlɛyɛli-belebele bɛ bɔ ⟨so kɔnɔ legen yɔrɔ la⟩ na; ani dibi-yayi bɛ bɔ yɛlɛyɛli-sanɔgɔw (saheli-yɛlɛyɛliw) fɛ.
